doc.text: The prefix to add to the translations ids.

fields.name: getNameID
fields.src: public inline function getNameID(name):String return prefix + name + "-name";

fields.name: getDescID

fields.name: getID
fields.src: public inline function getID(name):String return prefix + name;

fields.name: translate
fields.src: public function translate(name:String, ?args:Array<Dynamic>):String return TU.translate(getID(name), args);
